responses.body:
{{setVar 'novoNome' (bodyRaw 'name')}}{{#unless @novoNome}}{{setVar 'novoNome' (bodyRaw 'nome')}}{{/unless}}{{setVar 'novoEmail' (bodyRaw 'email')}}{{setVar 'novaSenha' (bodyRaw 'senha')}}{{#unless @novaSenha}}{{setVar 'novaSenha' (bodyRaw 'password')}}{{/unless}}{{setVar 'agora' (now)}}{{setVar 'novoId' (add (len (dataRaw 'usuariosCadastrados')) 1)}}{{setVar 'novoUsuario' (objectMerge (dataRaw 'usuarioDefault') (object id=@novoId name=@novoNome email=@novoEmail senha=@novaSenha createdAt=@agora updatedAt=@agora))}}{{setData 'push' 'usuariosCadastrados' '' @novoUsuario}}{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Cadastro realizado com sucesso",
  "data": {
    "id": {{@novoId}},
    "name": "{{@novoNome}}",
    "email": "{{@novoEmail}}",
    "pontosSaldo": {{objectPath @novoUsuario 'pontosSaldo'}},
    "qrCode": "{{objectPath @novoUsuario 'qrCode'}}",
    "token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9",
    "createdAt": "{{@agora}}",
    "updatedAt": "{{@agora}}"
  }
}
